# airflow-config

> Hydra and Pydantic configuration for declarative Apache Airflow DAGs

## Pages

- [airflow-config](index.html.md): Declarative Apache Airflow DAGs from Hydra YAML and airflow-pydantic models.
- [Tutorial: generate a DAG from YAML](docs/src/tutorial.html.md): In this tutorial, we will describe a two-task workflow in YAML, load its Pydantic models, and register the resulting DAG with Airflow.
- [How-to guides](docs/src/how-to.html.md): These guides cover configuration composition, materialization, templates, environment selection, and ecosystem integrations.
- [Why configuration and DAG models are separate](docs/src/explanation.html.md): airflow-config treats DAG authoring as configuration composition followed by materialization. Hydra composes YAML; Pydantic validates the resulting object gr...
- [API reference](docs/src/api.html.md): This reference is generated from public signatures and docstrings.
